name: Feature request

title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What's painful or impossible today?

## The proposed solution

What would you like to happen instead? Be specific — describe the user flow, not just the
implementation.

## Alternatives you've considered

What other ways could this be solved? Why are they worse?

## Scope

- **Who benefits?** (all users / a specific Android version / a specific use case)
- **Source language:** [ ] German (current)  [ ] other (which?)
- **Target language:** [ ] one of the 12 existing  [ ] new (which?)
- **Where does it happen?** [ ] tile  [ ] overlay  [ ] setup screen  [ ] CI / build  [ ] docs

## Mock / screenshot (optional)

If you have a sketch, mock, or reference app that does something similar, attach it here.

## Out of scope

What is explicitly **not** part of this request? (Helps keep the discussion focused.)

## Willing to contribute?

[ ] I'm willing to open a PR for this (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
[ ] I can help test a prototype build.
[ ] Just suggesting — anyone can pick it up.
